items.finding: Attenuated total reflection probes allow in-line measurements in demanding environments, and optical fiber systems can be used to reduce thermal influences.
items.how_it_applies: This supports considering ATR probes with fiber optics for challenging matrices, though thermal effects should still be tested.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The cited study focuses on chlorosilanes and strong acids rather than concentrated milk products, meaning fouling and temperature responses may differ significantly.

citation.quote: Attenuated total reflection probes (ATR) allow in-line measurements even in demanding measurement environments and reaction mixtures with highly oxidative and corrosive substances, such as chlorosilanes or strong acids and bases.
